title: Recurrent Neural Networks for Forecasting Autoregressive Noncausal Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.15296v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper examines the use of recurrent neural networks and their extensions for forecasting autoregressive causal-noncausal processes, characterized by local explosive patterns such as bubbles and spikes. We study the recurrent neural networks (RNN), long short-term memory networks (LSTM), gated recurrent unit (GRU), bidirectional LSTM, and also a simple feed-forward network (FNN) to reveal the difficulty of forecasting extreme values depending on the type of network and the length of the training set. We show that FNN outperforms other networks in predicting extreme values of a univariate noncausal time series during a bubble. We also examine the improvements of point predictions of extreme values resulting from pooling and a modified loss function.

translated_title: 用于预测自回归非因果过程的循环神经网络
translated_abstract: 本文研究了循环神经网络及其扩展模型在预测自回归因果-非因果过程中的应用，这类过程以泡沫和尖峰等局部爆炸性模式为特征。我们研究了循环神经网络（RNN）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）、门控循环单元（GRU）、双向LSTM，以及简单的前馈神经网络（FNN），以揭示极值预测的困难程度如何随网络类型和训练集长度而变化。我们的结果表明，在预测单变量非因果时间序列泡沫期间的极值时，FNN的表现优于其他网络。我们还探讨了通过池化方法和修改损失函数对极值点预测所带来的改进。
tldr: 该论文研究了RNN、LSTM、GRU等多种神经网络在预测具有泡沫等局部爆炸性模式的自回归非因果时间序列时的表现，发现简单的前馈神经网络（FNN）在预测泡沫期间极值方面优于循环类网络，且池化方法和修改后的损失函数可进一步提升极值点预测效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a simple feed-forward neural network (FNN) outperforms RNN, LSTM, GRU, and bidirectional LSTM in forecasting extreme values of univariate autoregressive noncausal time series during bubbles, and that pooling and a modified loss function further improve point predictions of extreme values.
